title: Cyberpunk Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with a shaved head, wearing a metallic bronze and black armored bodysuit with knee pads and boots. The sequence shows her running, then striking a combat stance as bright white and orange energy bursts explode from her fists and back.
prompt: A four-panel sequence of a fierce young woman with a shaved head and dark skin, wearing a form-fitting bronze and black tactical bodysuit with armored plates and brown boots. She is shown running forward then striking powerful combat poses, with explosive white and orange energy bursts erupting from her fists and back. Dramatic lighting, cinematic action style, character turnaround study against a dark background.
